name: Carbon coach answers a preset question about the user's footprint
description: A logged-in user opens the carbon coach page, clicks a preset question button, and the coach replies with an answer in the conversation area.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /auth/login and sign in with email 'demo@offset.io' and password 'Password123!'
Verify the 'Carbon coach' heading and the preset question buttons grid are visible, along with the initial coach greeting in the conversation area
Click the 'What is my largest emission source?' preset question button
Verify the conversation area shows a new coach response message below the user's question, and the response contains text about an emission source or footprint data
